                                                                                                                                                                    मुख्य बिंदु

                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                    • ग्रामीण-से-शहरी प्रवास का तात्पर्य गांवों से शहरों की ओर लोगों के पलायन से है, जो भारत में शहरीकरण की प्रक्रिया को महत्वपूर्ण रूप से बढ़ावा देता है। यह प्रवास महानगरों के तेजी से विस्तार और जनगणना शहरों (Census Towns) के उद्भव में योगदान देता है, जहाँ ग्रामीण बस्तियाँ जनसंख्या घनत्व और गैर-कृषि रोजगार के आधार पर शहरी संस्थाओं में परिवर्तित हो जाती हैं। अतः, कथन 1 सही है।
                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                    • हालाँकि शहर विभिन्न सुविधाएँ प्रदान करते हैं, लेकिन कथन 2 को सख्त सांख्यिकीय संदर्भ में गलत माना जाता है क्योंकि भारत की जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, भारत में प्रवास का सबसे बड़ा कारण विवाह बना हुआ है, विशेष रूप से महिला जनसांख्यिकी के लिए। इसके अलावा, अधिकांश श्रम प्रवास शहरी शिक्षा सुविधाओं के साधारण आकर्षण के बजाय ग्रामीण गरीबी और कृषि भूमि की कमी जैसे प्रतिकर्ष कारकों (Push Factors) से प्रेरित होता है। अतः, कथन 2 गलत है।
                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                     अतिरिक्त जानकारी1. Energy sector is the top contributor to India's GHG emissions.

                                                                                                                                                                    1. भारत के ग्रीनहाउस गैस उत्सर्जन में ऊर्जा क्षेत्र का सबसे बड़ा योगदान है।
                                                                                                                                                                    2. भारत का प्रति व्यक्ति उत्सर्जन वैश्विक औसत से अधिक है।
                                                                                                                                                                    3. रिपोर्ट में पर्यावरण प्रदर्शन सूचकांक में भारत को शीर्ष 10 देशों में स्थान दिया गया है।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "केवल 1"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "केवल 2"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "केवल 3"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "सभी 1, 2 और 3 सही हैं"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\nThe correct answer is Only 1.\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                    • The Energy sector is the largest contributor to India's Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions, accounting for approximately 75% of the total emissions due to the nation's high dependence on coal for electricity and the growth of the transportation sector. Hence, statement 1 is correct.
                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                    • India's per capita emissions are significantly lower than the global average; while the global average stands at approximately 6.3 tonnes of CO2 equivalent (tCO2e), India's average is only about 2.4 tCO2e, reflecting a vast disparity in consumption patterns compared to developed nations. Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.
                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                    • The Environmental Performance Index (EPI), which measures various sustainability indicators, has historically ranked India at the bottom of the table (e.g., 180th out of 180 countries in the 2022 report), primarily due to poor air quality and high carbon growth rates. Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.
                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                     Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                    • State of India's Environment Report 2024:\n
                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • This comprehensive report is published annually by the Centre for Science and Environment (CSE) and the magazine Down To Earth.
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • It provides data-driven insights into climate change, biodiversity loss, urbanization, water management, and public health within the Indian context.
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                    • Environmental Indices and Rankings:\n
                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • While India ranks poorly in the EPI, it consistently ranks among the top performers in the Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI), often placing in the top 10 (ranked 7th in CCPI 2024) due to its ambitious Renewable Energy targets and low per capita emissions.
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • The Energy sector breakdown includes Electricity generation (the largest sub-component), followed by Manufacturing, Construction, and Transport.
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • Other significant emission sources in India include the Agriculture sector (methane from livestock and rice cultivation) and Industrial Processes and Product Use (IPPU).
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • \nकेवल 1 है।\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                      मुख्य बिंदु

                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • ऊर्जा क्षेत्र भारत के ग्रीनहाउस गैस (GHG) उत्सर्जन में सबसे बड़ा योगदानकर्ता है, जो बिजली के लिए कोयले पर देश की उच्च निर्भरता और परिवहन क्षेत्र की वृद्धि के कारण कुल उत्सर्जन का लगभग 75% हिस्सा है। अतः, कथन 1 सही है।
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • भारत का प्रति व्यक्ति उत्सर्जन वैश्विक औसत की तुलना में काफी कम है; जबकि वैश्विक औसत लगभग 6.3 टन CO2 समकक्ष (tCO2e) है, भारत का औसत केवल लगभग 2.4 tCO2e है, जो विकसित देशों की तुलना में उपभोग पैटर्न में भारी असमानता को दर्शाता है। अतः, कथन 2 गलत है।
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • पर्यावरण प्रदर्शन सूचकांक (EPI), जो विभिन्न स्थिरता संकेतकों को मापता है, ने ऐतिहासिक रूप से भारत को तालिका में सबसे नीचे रखा है (उदाहरण के लिए, 2022 की रिपोर्ट में 180 देशों में से 180वां स्थान), मुख्य रूप से खराब वायु गुणवत्ता और उच्च कार्बन विकास दर के कारण। अतः, कथन 3 गलत है।
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n

                                                                                                                                                                       ", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Indexes and Reports"], "concept": "Indexes and Reports", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "69ca139638780db33823afb0", "qs_no": 23, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "The one nation, one tax initiative in India refers to:", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Income Tax"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Corporate Tax"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Goods and Services Tax (GST)"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Import Duties"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "भारत में एक राष्ट्र, एक कर पहल का तात्पर्य है:", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "आयकर"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "निगमित कर"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "वस्तु एवं सेवा कर (जीएसटी)"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "आयात करों"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\nThe correct answer is Goods and Services Tax (GST).\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • The Goods and Services Tax (GST) is a comprehensive, multi-stage, destination-based indirect tax that was designed to replace a complex web of central and state taxes in India.
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • The initiative was launched under the motto One Nation, One Tax, One Market to unify the Indian economy into a single common market, reducing internal trade barriers.
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • It came into effect on July 1, 2017, following the passage of the 101st Constitutional Amendment Act, 2016.
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • The primary objective of GST is to eliminate the cascading effect of taxes, which refers to the tax-on-tax system that existed under previous regimes like VAT, Excise Duty, and Service Tax.
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • By providing a seamless Input Tax Credit (ITC), GST ensures that tax is levied only on the value addition at each stage of the supply chain.
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                       Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • Direct Taxes (Not covered under the initiative):\n
                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                        • Income Tax: A direct tax levied on the annual earnings of individuals, Hindu Undivided Families (HUF), and other legal entities.
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                        • Corporate Tax: A direct tax paid by companies on their net profits or income earned from business operations.
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • Customs and Import Duties:\n
                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                        • These are taxes levied on goods entering or leaving the country, governed by the Customs Act, 1962, and are largely maintained outside the immediate GST framework.
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                      • GST Governance and Structure:\n
                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                        • The GST Council, chaired by the Union Finance Minister, is the constitutional body responsible for determining tax rates and policy changes.
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                        • The tax is divided into CGST (Central), SGST (State), and IGST (Integrated for inter-state trade).
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                        • Current standard tax slabs include 5%, 12%, 18%, and 28%, with certain essential items being exempt (0%).
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                        • \nवस्तु एवं सेवा कर (GST) है।\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        मुख्य बिंदु

                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                        • वस्तु एवं सेवा कर (GST) एक व्यापक, बहु-चरणीय, गंतव्य-आधारित अप्रत्यक्ष कर है जिसे भारत में केंद्रीय और राज्य करों के एक जटिल जाल को बदलने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया था।
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                        • भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था को एक साझा बाजार में एकीकृत करने और आंतरिक व्यापार बाधाओं को कम करने के लिए इस पहल को एक राष्ट्र, एक कर, एक बाजार के आदर्श वाक्य के तहत शुरू किया गया था।
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                        • यह 101वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 2016 के पारित होने के बाद 1 जुलाई, 2017 को लागू हुआ।
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                        • GST का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य करों के कैस्केडिंग प्रभाव (cascading effect) को समाप्त करना है, जो VAT, उत्पाद शुल्क और सेवा कर जैसे पिछले शासनों के तहत मौजूद कर-पर-कर प्रणाली को संदर्भित करता है।
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                        • एक निर्बाध इनपुट टैक्स क्रेडिट (ITC) प्रदान करके, GST यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि आपूर्ति श्रृंखला के प्रत्येक चरण में केवल मूल्यवर्धन (value addition) पर कर लगाया जाए।
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Simplify: (1/7) × 0.71785 ≈ 0.10255

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 0.10255.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Formula: Sum of Fractions = (Sum of adjusted numerators) ÷ LCM of denominators

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Prime factorization of denominators:

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 28 = 22 × 7

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 35 = 5 × 7

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 49 = 72

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 56 = 23 × 7

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ LCM(28, 35, 49, 56) = 23 × 5 × 72 = 8 × 5 × 49 = 1960

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Sum = (1960÷28 + 1960÷35 + 1960÷49 + 1960÷56", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Number System"], "concept": "Number System", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "69ca139843656e870cae8c99", "qs_no": 2, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "Evaluate: \\( (\\frac{1}{28}) + (\\frac{1}{35}) + (\\frac{1}{49}) + (\\frac{1}{56}) \\)", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "0.09285"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "0.08565"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "0.10255"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "0.07755"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "\\( (\\frac{1}{28}) + (\\frac{1}{35}) + (\\frac{1}{49}) + (\\frac{1}{56}) \\) का मूल्यांकन करें |", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "0.09285"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "0.08565"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "0.10255"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "0.07755"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Take 1/7 common: (1/7) × (1/4 + 1/5 + 1/7 + 1/8)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Convert to decimals: (1/7) × (0.25 + 0.2 + 0.14285 + 0.125)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Simplify: (1/7) × 0.71785 ≈ 0.10255

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 0.10255.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Given: Fractions are 1/28, 1/35, 1/49, and 1/56.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Formula: Sum of Fractions = (Sum of adjusted numerators) ÷ LCM of denominators

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Prime factorization of denominators:

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 28 = 22 × 7

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 35 = 5 × 7

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 49 = 72

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 56 = 23 × 7

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ LCM(28, 35, 49, 56) = 23 × 5 × 72 = 8 × 5 × 49 = 1960

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Sum = (1960÷28 + 1960÷35 + 1960÷49 + 1960÷56) ÷ 1960

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Sum = (70 + 56 + 40 + 35) ÷ 1960

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Sum = 201 ÷ 1960 ≈ 0.102551

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 0.10255.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        LCM of Denominators

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        To add fractions with different denominators, always find the Least Common Multiple (LCM) to create a common base for addition.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Decimal Approximation

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        When dividing by numbers like 7 or 49, the result is often a non-terminating decimal; rounding to 5 decimal places is standard for bank exams.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        BODMAS Rule

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Follow the order of operations: Brackets, Orders, Division/Multiplication, and then Addition/Subtraction for accurate evaluation. शॉर्टकट ट्रिक\n

                                                                                                                                                                        1/7 कॉमन लें: (1/7) × (1/4 + 1/5 + 1/7 + 1/8)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        दशमलव में बदलें: (1/7) × (0.25 + 0.2 + 0.14285 + 0.125)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        सरल करें: (1/7) × 0.71785 ≈ 0.10255

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ सही उत्तर 0.10255 है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        वैकल्पिक विधि

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        दिया गया है: भिन्न 1/28, 1/35, 1/49, और 1/56 हैं।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        सूत्र: भिन्नों का योग = (समायोजित अंशों का योग) ÷ हरों का LCM

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ हरों का अभाज्य गुणनखंडन:

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 28 = 22 × 7

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 35 = 5 × 7

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 49 = 72

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 56 = 23 × 7

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ LCM(28, 35, 49, 56) = 23 × 5 × 72 = 8 × 5 × 49 = 1960

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ योग = (1960÷28 + 1960÷35 + 1960÷49 + 1960÷56) ÷ 1960

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ योग = (70 + 56 + 40 + 35) ÷ 1960

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ योग = 201 ÷ 1960 ≈ 0.102551

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ सही उत्तर 0.10255 है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        अतिरिक्त जानकारी

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        हरों का LCM

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        अलग-अलग हरों वाली भिन्नों को जोड़ने के लिए, जोड़ने हेतु एक समान आधार बनाने के लिए हमेशा लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य (LCM) ज्ञात करें।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        दशमलव सन्निकटन

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        जब 7 या 49 जैसी संख्याओं से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो परिणाम अक्सर एक अशांत दशमलव होता है; बैंक परीक्षाओं के लिए 5 दशमलव स्थानों तक पूर्णांकित करना मानक है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        BODMAS नियम

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        सटीक मूल्यांकन के लिए संक्रियाओं के क्रम का पालन करें: कोष्ठक (Brackets), घातांक (Orders), भाग/गुणा (Division/Multiplication), और फिर जोड़/घटाव (Addition/Subtraction)।

                                                                                                                                                                        \na9:Tc93,\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Investment Ratio M : N = 80,000 : 1,20,000 = 2 : 3

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Interest for N = 10% of 1,20,000 = ₹12,000

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Remaining Profit = 33,000 − (10% of 2,00,000) = 33,000 − 20,000 = ₹13,000

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        N's share in remaining profit = (3 ÷ 5) × 13,000 = ₹7,800

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Total share of N = 12,000 + 7,800 = ₹19,800

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is ₹19,800.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Given: M's investment = ₹80,000, N's investment = ₹1,20,000, Total Profit = ₹33,000, Interest Rate = 10%.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Formula: Total Share = Interest on Capital + (Profit Ratio × Remaining Profit)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Total Capital = 80,000 + 1,20,000 = ₹2,00,000

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Total Interest = 10% of 2,00,000 = ₹20,000

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Remaining Profit = 33,000 − 20,000 = ₹13,000

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Investment Ratio (M : N) = 80,000 : 1,20,000 = 2 : 3

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ N's Interest = 10% of 1,20,000 = ₹12,000

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ N's Profit Share = (3 ÷ 5) × 13,000 = ₹7,800

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ N's Total Share = 12,000 + 7,800 = ₹19,800

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is ₹19,800.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Profit Sharing Ratio

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        In a partnership, profit is shared in the ratio of (Capital × Time). If time is the same, profit ratio = capital ratio.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Interest on Capital

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Interest is calculated on the individual capital of each partner and is usually subtracted from the gross profit before distributing the remainder.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Active vs Sleeping Partner

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        An active partner manages the business and may receive a salary or extra profit percentage, while a sleeping partner only invests capital.

                                                                                                                                                                        वैकल्पिक विधि Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Age of new person = Age of replaced person + (Total people × Increase in average)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Age of new person = 14 + (8 × 2)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Age of new person = 14 + 16 = 30 years

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 30.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Given:

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Total number of people = 8

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Age of the person replaced = 14 years

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Increase in average age = 2 years

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Age of new person = Age of replaced person + (Total number of people × Increase in average)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Total increase in the sum of ages of the group = Number of people × Increase in average age

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Total increase = 8 × 2 = 16 years

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Since the average increased, the new person must be older than the person who left.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Age of new person = Age of replaced person + Total increase

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Age of new person = 14 + 16

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Age of new person = 30 years

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 30.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Average Definition

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        The average of a set of numbers is the sum of the numbers divided by the count of those numbers. Average = Sum ÷ Count.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Replacement Logic

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        When one person is replaced, the total count remains the same. If the average increases, the incoming value > outgoing value. If it decreases, incoming < outgoing.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Average of First n Natural Numbers

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        The average of the first n natural numbers is (n + 1) ÷ 2. For example, the average of 1 to 10 is 5.5. शॉर्टकट ट्रिक\n
