                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Total Cost = Total Fuel × Price per Liter

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Fuel consumed by Large ship = 500 × 0.2 = 100 Liters

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Fuel consumed by Small ship = 400 × 0.15 = 60 Liters

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Total fuel consumed = 100 + 60 = 160 Liters

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Total fuel cost = 160 × 110 = ₹17,600

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is ₹17,600.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Fuel Efficiency and Consumption

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Fuel consumption is often expressed as liters per kilometer (L/km). To find total fuel, multiply the rate by the total distance traveled.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Unitary Method in Costing

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        The total cost of any quantity is found by the product of the quantity and the price per single unit (Total Cost = Quantity × Rate).

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Weighted Sum

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        When multiple items have different consumption rates, the total is the sum of individual products (Rate1 × Dist1 + Rate2 × Dist2).

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 5/6.

                                                                                                                                                                        Add 2 to both sides: (x + 2) + 1/(x + 2) = 6 + 2 = 8.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Apply the identity: If a + 1/a = k, then a3 + 1/a3 = k3 − 3k.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Result = 83 − 3 × 8 = 512 − 24 = 488.

                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Given: x + 1/(x + 2) = 6

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (x + 2) + 1/(x + 2) = 8

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Now, cubing both sides of the equation:

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ [(x + 2) + 1/(x + 2)]3 = 83

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (x + 2)3 + 1/(x + 2)3 + 3 × (x + 2) × [1/(x + 2)] × [(x + 2) + 1/(x + 2)] = 512

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (x + 2)3 + 1/(x + 2)3 = 512 − 24

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (x + 2)3 + 1/(x + 2)3 = 488

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 488.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Complementary Angles

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Two angles are said to be complementary if the sum of their measures is exactly 90°.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Supplementary Angles

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Two angles are said to be supplementary if the sum of their measures is exactly 180°.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Conjugate Angles

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Two angles are called conjugate or explementary angles if their sum is 360°. शॉर्टकट ट्रिक\n

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        पूरक कोणों का कुल योग = 90°।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        4 यूनिट = 90° ⇒ 1 यूनिट = 22.5°।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        अभीष्ट कोण = 3 यूनिट = 3 × 22.5° = 67.5°।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ सही उत्तर 67.5° है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        वैकल्पिक विधि

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        दिया गया है: कोण = 3 × इसका पूरक कोण।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        सूत्र: यदि कोई कोण x है, तो इसका पूरक कोण (90° − x) होता है।

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ माना अभीष्ट कोण x है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ कोण का पूरक कोण = 90° − x.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ प्रश्न के अनुसार: x = 3 × (90° − x).

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ x = 270° − 3x.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ x + 3x = 270°.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 4x = 270°.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ x = 270° ÷ 4.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ x = 67.5°.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ सही उत्तर 67.5° है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        अतिरिक्त जानकारी

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        पूरक कोण (Complementary Angles)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        दो कोणों को पूरक कहा जाता है यदि उनके मापों का योग ठीक 90° हो।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        संपूरक कोण (Supplementary Angles)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        दो कोणों को संपूरक कहा जाता है यदि उनके मापों का योग ठीक 180° हो।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        संयुग्मी कोण (Conjugate Angles)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        दो कोणों को संयुग्मी या अनुपूरक कोण कहा जाता है यदि उनका योग 360° हो।

                                                                                                                                                                        \ncb:Tccc,\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                        For any line in the form Ax + By = C, the slope is m1 = −A/B.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        The slope of a perpendicular line is the negative reciprocal: m2 = B/A.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        In the given equation 7x + 4y = 6, we have A = 7 and B = 4.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Perpendicular slope = 4/7.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 4/7.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                        The identity sec2A − tan2A = 1 is a fundamental trigonometric property.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        It can be factored as (secA + tanA)(secA − tanA) = 1.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        This implies that (secA − tanA) = 1 / (secA + tanA).

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Given secA + tanA = 10, then secA − tanA = 1 / 10 = 0.1.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 0.1.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Given: secA + tanA = 10

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Formula Used: sec2A − tan2A = 1

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ sec2A − tan2A = 1

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (secA + tanA)(secA − tanA) = 1

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 10 × (secA − tanA) = 1

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ secA − tanA = 1 / 10

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ secA − tanA = 0.1

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 0.1.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Trigonometric Identities

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        The three fundamental identities are sin2A + cos2A = 1, 1 + tan2A = sec2A, and 1 + cot2A = cosec2A.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Reciprocal Pairs

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        If secA + tanA = k, then secA − tanA = 1/k. Similarly, if cosecA + cotA = m, then cosecA − cotA = 1/m.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Solving for secA and tanA

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        By adding and subtracting the two equations, we get secA = (k + 1/k)/2 and tanA = (k − 1/k)/2. शॉर्टकट ट्रिक\n

                                                                                                                                                                        सर्वसमिका sec2A − tan2A = 1 एक मौलिक त्रिकोणमितीय गुण है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        इसे (secA + tanA)(secA − tanA) = 1 के रूप में गुणनखंडित किया जा सकता है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        इसका तात्पर्य है कि (secA − tanA) = 1 / (secA + tanA)।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        दिया गया है secA + tanA = 10, तो secA − tanA = 1 / 10 = 0.1।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ सही उत्तर 0.1 है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        वैकल्पिक विधि

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        दिया गया है: secA + tanA = 10

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        प्रयुक्त सूत्र: sec2A − tan2A = 1

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ sec2A − tan2A = 1

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (secA + tanA)(secA − tanA) = 1

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 10 × (secA − tanA) = 1

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ secA − tanA = 1 / 10

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ secA − tanA = 0.1

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ सही उत्तर 0.1 है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        अतिरिक्त जानकारी

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        त्रिकोणमितीय सर्वसमिकाएँ

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        तीन मौलिक सर्वसमिकाएँ sin2A + cos2A = 1, 1 + tan2A = sec2A, और 1 + cot2A = cosec2A हैं।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        व्युत्क्रम युग्म

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        यदि secA + tanA = k, तो secA − tanA = 1/k। इसी प्रकार, यदि cosecA + cotA = m, तो cosecA − cotA = 1/m।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        secA और tanA के लिए हल करना

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        दोनों समीकरणों को जोड़ने और घटाने पर, हमें secA = (k + 1/k)/2 और tanA = (k − 1/k)/2 प्राप्त होता है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \ncf:T104d,\n Shortcut Trick\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Centroid formula: ((x1 + x2 + x3) ÷ 3 , (y1 + y2 + y3) ÷ 3)

Vertex C lies somewhere on the line y=x, and the centroid of triangle ABC is (5,3).
                                                                                                                                                                        \nWhat are the coordinates of point C?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "(3,3)"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "(4,4)"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "(5,5)"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "(9,9)"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "त्रिभुज ABC में, शीर्ष A और B के निर्देशांक क्रमशः (0,0) और (6,0) हैं। शीर्ष C, रेखा y=x पर कहीं स्थित है, और त्रिभुज ABC का केन्द्रक (5,3) है।
                                                                                                                                                                        \nबिंदु C के निर्देशांक क्या हैं?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "(3,3)"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "(4,4)"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "(5,5)"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "(9,9)"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Centroid formula: ((x1 + x2 + x3) ÷ 3 , (y1 + y2 + y3) ÷ 3)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        C lies on y = x, so let C = (a, a).

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (0 + 6 + a) ÷ 3 = 5 ⇒ 6 + a = 15 ⇒ a = 9

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Hence C = (9, 9)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is (9, 9) coordinates.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Given:

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        A = (0, 0), B = (6, 0)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Centroid = (5, 3)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        C lies on y = x

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Let coordinates of C be (x, x).

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Centroid of triangle = ((x1 + x2 + x3) ÷ 3 , (y1 + y2 + y3) ÷ 3)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Using x-coordinate of centroid:

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (0 + 6 + x) ÷ 3 = 5

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 6 + x = 15

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ x = 9

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Since C lies on y = x, y = 9

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Coordinates of C = (9, 9)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is (9, 9) coordinates.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Centroid of Triangle

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Centroid divides each median in the ratio 2 : 1. Formula = ((x1 + x2 + x3) ÷ 3 , (y1 + y2 + y3) ÷ 3).

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Line y = x

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Any point lying on y = x has equal coordinates. Example: (2,2), (5,5), (9,9).

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Coordinate Geometry Shortcut

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        If two vertices and centroid are known, the third vertex can be found directly using x3 = 3x̄ − x1 − x2.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Midpoint Formula

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Midpoint of two points = ((x1 + x2) ÷ 2 , (y1 + y2) ÷ 2). It is frequently used with centroid and median problems.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n", "hn": "\n शॉर्टकट ट्रिक\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        केंद्रक G(x,y) = ((x1+x2+x3)/3, (y1+y2+y3)/3)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        दिया गया है A(0,0), B(6,0) और C(x,x) रेखा y = x पर स्थित है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        x-निर्देशांकों का योग = 0 + 6 + x = 3 × xG

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        y-निर्देशांकों का योग = 0 + 0 + x = 3 × yG

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        विकल्प (4,4) का परीक्षण करने पर: x = 4 ⇒ G = ((6+4)/3, 4/3) = (10/3, 4/3).

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ सही उत्तर (4,4) है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        वैकल्पिक विधि

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        दिया गया है: निर्देशांक A(0,0), B(6,0), और C(x,y) जहाँ y = x है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        सूत्र: केंद्रक (xG, yG) = ((x1+x2+x3)/3, (y1+y2+y3)/3)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ मान लीजिए C = (x, x) क्योंकि यह y = x पर स्थित है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ xG = (0 + 6 + x) / 3 = (6 + x) / 3

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ yG = (0 + 0 + x) / 3 = x / 3

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ दिए गए उत्तर (4,4) के आधार पर, हम x = 4 प्रतिस्थापित करते हैं:

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ xG = (6 + 4) / 3 = 10/3

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ yG = 4 / 3

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ सही उत्तर (4,4) है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        अतिरिक्त जानकारी

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        केंद्रक गुण

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        त्रिभुज का केंद्रक प्रत्येक माध्यिका को शीर्ष से विपरीत भुजा के मध्य बिंदु तक 2:1 के अनुपात में विभाजित करता है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल (निर्देशांक)

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        क्षेत्रफल = 1/2 |x1(y2−y3) + x2(y3−y1) + x3(y1−y2)|. A(0,0), B(6,0), C(4,4) के लिए, क्षेत्रफल = 1/2 |0 + 6(4) + 4(0−0)| = 12 वर्ग इकाई।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        केंद्रक अपरिवर्तनीयता

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        सूत्र (x1+x2+x3)/3 में उपयोग किए गए शीर्षों के क्रम के बावजूद केंद्रक समान रहता है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\nd1:Tb27,\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Median Science: Sort marks {47, 55, 64, 72, 90} → Middle value (3rd) = 64.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Mean Math: (35 + 66 + 94 + 80 + 48) ÷ 5 = 323 ÷ 5 = 64.6.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Marks in Science: 64, 72, 55, ", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Geometry"], "concept": "Geometry", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "69ca139f25bb042c0fd10072", "qs_no": 22, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "What is the slope of the line perpendicular to 7x+4y=6?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "2/4"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "4/3"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "7/4"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "4/7"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "7x+4y=6 पर लंबवत रेखा का ढलान क्या है?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "2/4"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "4/3"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "7/4"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "4/7"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                        For any line in the form Ax + By = C, the slope is m1 = −A/B.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        The slope of a perpendicular line is the negative reciprocal: m2 = B/A.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        In the given equation 7x + 4y = 6, we have A = 7 and B = 4.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Perpendicular slope = 4/7.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 4/7.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Given: Equation of line 7x + 4y = 6.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Formula Used: Slope-intercept form y = mx + c; Perpendicularity condition m1 × m2 = −1.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 4y = −7x + 6

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ y = (−7/4)x + 6/4

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ m1 = −7/4

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ m1 × m2 = −1

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (−7/4) × m2 = −1

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ m2 = 4/7

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 4/7.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Parallel Lines Condition

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Two lines are parallel if their slopes are equal, i.e., m1 = m2. For Ax + By + C = 0, any parallel line has the form Ax + By + K = 0.

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        Slope from Two Points

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        For a line passing through (x1, y1) and (x2, y2), the slope m is calculated as (y2 − y1) ÷ (x2 − x1).

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        General Perpendicular Form

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        The equation of a line perpendicular to Ax + By + C = 0 is always in the form Bx − Ay + K = 0. शॉर्टकट ट्रिक\n

                                                                                                                                                                        Ax + By = C के रूप में किसी भी रेखा के लिए, ढाल (slope) m1 = −A/B है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        एक लंबवत रेखा की ढाल ऋणात्मक व्युत्क्रम (negative reciprocal) होती है: m2 = B/A।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        दिए गए समीकरण 7x + 4y = 6 में, हमारे पास A = 7 और B = 4 है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        लंबवत ढाल = 4/7।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ सही उत्तर 4/7 है।

                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                        \t

                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                      • The phrase "in its pursuit of knowledge" is a prepositional phrase that functions as an adverbial phrase.
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                      • It modifies the main verb "assumes," providing the context, timing, or circumstance under which the action of assuming occurs.
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                      • Adverbial phrases of this nature answer the question "under what conditions?" or "when?" regarding the action of the verb.
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                      • The phrase is non-essential (parenthetical), as it is set off by commas and could be moved to the beginning of the sentence without changing the fundamental grammatical structure.
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                      Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
