                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                      \n“...the apparent duality of subject and object is thus sublated in the dialectic...”", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Removed"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Repressed"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Preserved and transformed"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Ignored"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "संदर्भ में शब्द “sublated” के लिए सबसे अच्छा पर्यायवाची शब्द क्या है:

                                                                                                                                                                      “...इस प्रकार विषय और वस्तु की स्पष्ट द्वैतता द्वंद्वात्मकता में उपलादित (sublated) होती है...”", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "हटाया गया"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "दबाया गया"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "संरक्षित और रूपांतरित"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "अनदेखा किया गया"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                      The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. preserved and transformed.

                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                      • The word "sublated" in the context of philosophy, particularly in Hegelian dialectics, means:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                        • The process by which contradictions are overcome and preserved by being transformed into a higher unity. (सुरक्षित और रूपांतरित किया गया)
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                      • In the sentence provided, "...the apparent duality of subject and object is thus sublated in the dialectic...," "sublated" implies that the duality is both preserved and transformed within the dialectical process.
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                      • Preserved and transformed means maintaining the essential aspects while also changing them into a higher form of unity or understanding.
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                      • Example: The contradictions of the previous argument were sublated into a greater synthesis.
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                      Therefore, the best synonym for "sublated" in the given context is: preserved and transformed.

                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                      Here are the other options and their meanings:

                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                      • Removed (हटाया गया): Taken away or gotten rid of.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The stains were removed from the fabric.
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                      • Repressed (दबाया गया): Restrained or suppressed.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The emotions were repressed to prevent conflict.
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                      • Ignored (अनदेखा किया गया): Paid no attention to.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The warning signs were ignored by the workers.
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                        • The paradox Hegel describes centers on the need for mutual recognition between two self-conscious beings.
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                        • The master seeks to be recognized as superior by the slave, but in doing so, he treats the slave as an object or instrument rather than an independent person.
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                        • Because the recognition comes from someone the master considers "subhuman" or dependent, it is hollow and one-sided, failing to provide the master with true self-certainty.
                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                        • Conversely, the slave, through the "labor of experience" and transforming the material world, eventually achieves a higher level of self-awareness and independence than the master.

                                                                                                                                                                        Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

                                                                                                                                                                              • \n \n

                                                                                                                                                                              • Example: The continuous rainfall caused flooding in several areas.
                                                                                                                                                                                • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                • \n

(स्थिति विडंबना)
                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: A fire station burns down.                                                                                                                                                                                   \n
                                                                                                                                                                                • It is often used in storytelling to create surprise or humor, highlighting the unpredictability of life. (जीवन की अप्रत्याशितता को दर्शाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।)
                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                Therefore, the correct answer is: Situational Irony.

                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: According to Kantianism, we cannot perceive objects as they are in themselves but only as they appear to us through our mental framework.
                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                • The concept implies that humans have innate forms of understanding (such as time, space, and causality) that filter and shape all experiences, preventing us from accessing the \"thing-in-itself.\" (वस्तु स्वयं में)
                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Kantianism.

                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                • Phenomenalism (प्रतीतिवाद): The view that physical objects exist only as perceptual phenomena or mental representations and cannot be known independently of perception.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: Phenomenalism argues that objects exist only insofar as they are perceived by a conscious observer.
                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                • Idealism (आदर्शवाद): The philosophical belief that reality is mentally constructed or immaterial, emphasizing that the mind or spirit shapes the world.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: Idealism asserts that the material world is an illusion, and true reality is rooted in ideas or consciousness.

                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

(जीवन की अप्रत्याशितता को दर्शाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।)
                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                Therefore, the correct answer is: Situational Irony.

                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                • Antithesis (विरोधाभास): A rhetorical device where two opposite ideas are put together in a sentence to achieve a contrasting effect.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: \"It was the best of times, it was the worst of times.\" — Charles Dickens.
                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                • Verbal Irony (मौखिक विडंबना): A figure of speech in which what is said is the opposite of what is meant.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: Saying \"What a pleasant day!\" during a thunderstorm.
                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                • Paradox (विरोधाभास): A statement that contradicts itself but might still be true.\n
                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: \"This is the beginning of the end.\"
                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                        Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                        • The phrase "as...as" is used to compare two things that are equal in some way.
                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                        • In this construction, you must use the positive degree (the simplest form) of the adjective or adverb, not the comparative form. Therefore, "better" (comparative) must be changed.
                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                        • Because the word modifies the verb "sings," we must use the adverb "well" rather than the adjective "good."
                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                        Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.
                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                        Complete Sentence: "She sings as well as a trained vocalist."
                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                        • Option 2: "as good as" is often used in informal conversation, but "good" is an adjective. Grammatically, it should describe a person or thing, not the action of singing.
                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                        • Option 3: "so better than" incorrectly combines the comparative "better than" with "so," which does not follow a standard comparison rule.
                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                        • Option 4: "as better than" is ungrammatical as it mixes the equality structure ("as") with the comparative structure ("than").
                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                        ", "hn": "\n
                                                                                                                                                                                        सही उत्तर 'as well as' है।
                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                        मुख्य बिंदु
                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                        • वाक्यांश \"as...as\" का उपयोग दो चीजों की तुलना करने के लिए किया जाता है जो किसी तरह से समान हैं।
                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                        • इस संरचना में, आपको विशेषण या क्रियाविशेषण की सकारात्मक डिग्री (सबसे सरल रूप) का उपयोग करना चाहिए, न कि तुलनात्मक रूप का। इसलिए, \"better\" (तुलनात्मक) को बदलना होगा।
                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                        • चूंकि यह शब्द क्रिया \"sings\" को संशोधित करता है, इसलिए हमें विशेषण \"good\" के बजाय क्रियाविशेषण \"well\" का उपयोग करना चाहिए।
                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                        इसलिए, सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।
                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                        पूर्ण वाक्य: \"She sings as well as a trained vocalist.\"
                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                        अतिरिक्त जानकारी
                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n“कितना अजीब है कि आज तक किसी ने गुम हुई फाइल पर ध्यान नहीं दिया!” क्लर्क चिल्लाया।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "क्लर्क चिल्लाया कि यह अजीब था कि आज तक किसी ने गुम हुई फाइल पर ध्यान नहीं दिया।"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "क्लर्क चिल्लाया कि यह अजीब था कि उस दिन तक किसी ने गुम हुई फाइल पर ध्यान नहीं दिया था।"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "क्लर्क ने कहा कि यह अजीब था कि अब तक किसी ने फाइल पर ध्यान नहीं दिया था।"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "क्लर्क ने चिल्लाते हुए कहा कि कितना अजीब है कि किसी ने फाइल पर ध्यान नहीं दिया था।"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Indirect Speech: The clerk exclaimed that it was strange that no one had noticed the missing file until that day.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Key Conversions:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Tense Change:\n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The verb "noticed" (Simple Past) in direct speech changes to "had noticed" (Past Perfect) in indirect speech because the reporting verb ("exclaimed") is in the past tense.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Time Expression Change:\n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The word "today" is a word of "nearness" and must be changed to "that day" to indicate distance in indirect speech.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Sentence Type:\n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The original sentence is exclamatory ("How strange...!").
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • In indirect speech, the exclamation is transformed into an assertive structure: "exclaimed that it was strange that...".
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Pronoun/Subject:\n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • "Nobody" and "no one" are often interchangeable in reporting, but the tense and time markers are the primary indicators of the correct option.
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                  Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                  Correct Sentence: “The clerk exclaimed that it was strange that no one had noticed the missing file until that day.”
                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                  Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Option 1: Fails to change the tense from "noticed" to "had noticed" and fails to change "today" to "that day."
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Option 3: Incorrectly uses "till now" (which should be "until then" or "until that day") and uses the reporting verb "said," which loses the emotive force of the exclamation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Option 4: Incorrectly retains the exclamatory word "how" in the reported clause and omits the time reference entirely.

                                                                                                                                                                                                        The correct answer is Option 1.

                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Indirect Speech: She asked whether, in view of the delays caused by external vendors, the timeline for delivery could be reconsidered.

                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Key Conversions:\n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The conjunction &a", "hn": "\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                              सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                              मुख्य बिंदु
                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                              • अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण: उसने पूछा कि क्या बाहरी विक्रेताओं के कारण हुई देरी के मद्देनजर वितरण के लिए समय-सीमा पर पुनर्विचार किया जा सकता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                              • मुख्य रूपांतरण:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \"whether... the timeline... could be reconsidered\" (क्या... समय-सीमा पर... पुनर्विचार किया जा सकता है) बन जाता है \"Could the delivery timeline be reconsidered...?\" (क्या वितरण समय-सीमा पर पुनर्विचार किया जा सकता है...?)\n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • संयोजक \"whether\" (क्या) इंगित करता है कि मूल कथन एक हाँ/नहीं प्रश्न था।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • वाक्यांश \"could be reconsidered\" (पुनर्विचार किया जा सकता है) निष्क्रिय आवाज में है। विकल्प 1 एकमात्र ऐसा विकल्प है जो इस निष्क्रिय संरचना (\"be reconsidered\" - पुनर्विचार किया जा सकता है) को बनाए रखता है, यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि व्याकरणिक रूप सुसंगत रहे।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • अप्रत्यक्ष भाषण में मोडल \"could\" (सकता है) को अनुरोध के औपचारिक और विनम्र स्वरूप को बनाए रखने के लिए प्रत्यक्ष भाषण में बरकरार रखा जाता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • रिपोर्टिंग क्रिया:\n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • अप्रत्यक्ष: \"asked\" (पूछा)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • प्रत्यक्ष: \"asked\" (पूछा) (रिपोर्टिंग खंड के रूप में अंत में रखा गया)।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                              • विराम चिह्न और प्रारूप:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • रिपोर्ट किया गया भाषण उद्धरण चिह्नों में संलग्न है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • वाक्य एक बड़े अक्षर से शुरू होता है और एक प्रश्नवाचक चिह्न (\"?\") के साथ समाप्त होता है क्योंकि \"whether\" (क्या) ने एक प्रश्नवाचक खंड पेश किया था।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                              इसलिए, सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                              सही वाक्य: “क्या बाहरी विक्रेताओं की देरी के कारण वितरण समय-सीमा पर पुनर्विचार किया जा सकता है?” उसने पूछा।
                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                              अतिरिक्त जानकारी
                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                              • विकल्प 2: वॉइस को निष्क्रिय (\"be reconsidered\" - पुनर्विचार किया जा सकता है) से सक्रिय (\"can you review\" - क्या आप समीक्षा कर सकते हैं) में बदलता है और शब्दावली (\"timeline\" को \"schedule\" - समय-सीमा को अनुसूची) में बदलाव करता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                              • विकल्प 3: एक अलग प्रारंभिक वाक्यांश (\"Would it be possible to...\" - क्या यह संभव होगा...) पेश करता है, जो विनम्र होते हुए भी अप्रत्यक्ष वाक्य में प्रदान की गई विशिष्ट व्याकरणिक संरचना से विचलित होता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                              • विकल्प 4: \"reconsidered\" (पुनर्विचार किया गया) के बजाय \"extended\" (बढ़ाया गया) और \"timeline\" (समय-सीमा) के बजाय \"deadline\" (अंतिम तिथि) का उपयोग करके अर्थ को बदलता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n101:T11a9,\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                              The correct answer is Option 2.
                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Indirect Speech: The clerk exclaimed that it was strange that no one had noticed the missing file until that day.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Key Conversions:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Tense Change:\n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The verb "noticed" (Simple Past) in direct speech changes to "had noticed" (Past Perfect) in indirect speech because the reporting verb ("exclaimed") is in the past tense.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Time Expression Change:\n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The word "today" is a word of "nearness" and must be changed to "that day" to indicate distance in indirect speech.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Sentence Type:\n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The original sentence is exclamatory ("How strange...!").
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • In indirect speech, the exclamation is transformed into an assertive structure: "exclaimed that it was strange that...".
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Pronoun/Subject:\n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • "Nobody" and "no one" are often interchangeable in reporting, but the tense and time markers are the primary indicators of the correct option.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                              P: while the committee deliberated on the proposed reforms, Q: numerous stakeholders voiced their concerns R: regarding the potential impacts S: during the public consultation process", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "RSPQ"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "QPRS"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "QSRP"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "PRQS"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "एक सार्थक वाक्य बनाने के लिए निम्नलिखित वाक्यों को सही क्रम में व्यवस्थित करें
                                                                                                                                                                                                              P: जबकि समिति ने प्रस्तावित सुधारों पर विचार-विमर्श किया, Q: कई हितधारकों ने अपनी चिंताएँ व्यक्त कीं R: संभावित प्रभावों के संबंध में S: सार्वजनिक परामर्श प्रक्रिया के दौरान", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "RSPQ"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "QPRS"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "QSRP"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "PRQS"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                              The correct answer is Option (3) i.e. QSRP.
                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
